question: What is the role of the air cleaner during engine backfires?

options.text: It acts as a flame arrester.

solution:
The correct answer is __It acts as a flame arrester.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Air Cleaner__ in an engine plays a crucial role during backfires.
 
• It acts as a flame arrester to prevent damage to the engine.
 
• During a backfire, the air cleaner helps contain flames and prevents them from spreading.
 
• This protective feature is critical for engine safety and longevity.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Engine Backfires:**

 
 
• Engine backfires occur when the combustion process happens outside the engine cylinders.
 
• This can result from an improper air-fuel mixture or timing issues.
 
 
 
• **Flame Arrester Benefits:**
 
 
• Prevents damage to sensitive engine components.
 
• Ensures safety during unexpected engine issues.
